sections.title: Advanced Seminar in Philosophy: The Empowerment of Women and Girls
sections.description: An advanced seminar in PPE offered by faculty in Philosophy. As an advanced interdisciplinary seminar, this course is open to juniors and seniors with a declared PPE major (open to others by departmental permission). For a detailed course description visit: https://ppe.sas.upenn.edu/study/curriculum/advanced-interdisciplinary-courses
